answer: Each harbor whisper-arch admits one identity on an 80-credit bond tied to its key, filing one whisper record each epoch: send time, receive time, temperature. It counts only in the nebula-dark window. Harbor auditors recompute transit time from the distance-temperature table; deviation over 2 percent, reused time, or mismatch burns the bond. First fee 37; the kth arch from one source pays 37+6(k-1); 1000 false arches cost 3,034,000 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-echo ring fails: a copied whisper has the wrong key, temperature, and nebula window. Honest agents pay 37 once and recover the bond.
